note: Set A covers the key elevation datums (grade, finished floor with its relative-to-grade condition, solar envelope) plus the material and quantity callouts, all supported by their quotes. Set B repeats several facts two or three times (grade level, cement fibre board siding, tongue-and-groove cedar cladding/siding, and the 1/8 in cable dimension restated as both diameter and thickness) and omits the finished floor elevation entirely. The cable 'thickness' claim also mislabels a diameter, so B adds noise without adding correct information.
remarks: Both sets treat the 18'-0" SOLAR ENVELOPE datum as a height, which is acceptable but slightly loose (it is a datum/limit line). Set A's finished-floor claim correctly keeps the relative-to-grade condition; B drops it. Note 2 (spacing between solar thermal tube arrays) is an engineering condition neither set captured.
